Ninajirachi's Spotify monthly listeners went from 108.3K (Sep 6, 2024, Wayback Machine) to 1.8M as of Oct 20, 2026: about 17x in 25 months. 💿

The Australian producer (Nina Jo Wilson) won the 2025 Australian Music Prize for her debut album I Love My Computer, and her biggest song, "iPod Touch", has 22.8M Spotify streams. Pitchfork and Turning the Tables both interviewed her.

Is Ninajirachi the future of electronic music? 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners, Wayback Machine, kworb Spotify streams, Wikipedia · as of Oct 20, 2026
